name: CompatShield – WP Compatibility & Upgrade Checker
author: compatshield

sections.description:
The CompatShield – WP Compatibility & Upgrade Checker helps you keep your WordPress site stable, secure, and future-ready by scanning your environment for PHP, Database, and Plugin compatibility issues.

With WordPress 7.0 introducing stricter database requirements, CompatShield ensures your site is fully prepared before you update.

🆕 WordPress 7.0 Readiness Check

WordPress 7.0 introduces stricter database requirements (MySQL 8.0+ / MariaDB 10.6+).
Many hosting environments still run older database versions, which can silently block updates.

CompatShield now detects:
– Database version compatibility
– Upgrade blockers before they break your site
– Hosting risks that may prevent future updates

Stay ahead of breaking changes before they impact your site.

$1/month License Required (Entry Plan)
You must subscribe to the CompatShield Portal ($1/month recurring) to obtain a license key. Once activated, you will be able to see compatibility results directly inside your WordPress admin.

📺 Video Tutorial
Watch step-by-step how to activate your license & run your first scan:

🚀 Quick Setup Steps

1) Subscribe → Get your license key from the Portal
2) Add your domain inside the License tab
3) Copy your License Key
4) Paste License Key inside Plugin Settings in WP Admin
5) Click Validate License
6) Click Save Settings
7) Go to Plugin Main Page → Click Rescan

✨ Key Features

  • PHP Compatibility Check
    Scan plugins for PHP compatibility.

    • $1/month: Shows PHP compatibility results inside WP Admin (up to PHP 8.5)
    • Pro: Deep insights and analysis inside Portal Dashboard

  • Database Compatibility Check (NEW 🚀)
    Detect your hosting database version (MySQL/MariaDB) and ensure compatibility with WordPress 7.0 and future updates.

    • Identifies outdated MySQL (< 8.0) and MariaDB (< 10.6)
    • Warns if your hosting may block WordPress updates
    • Helps prevent upgrade failures due to database incompatibility
    • Pro: Advanced insights and upgrade recommendations

  • Plugin Compatibility Scanner
    Check installed plugins against WordPress and PHP compatibility signals.

  • Plugin Rescan
    Quickly rescan whenever you install or update plugins.

  • Portal Integration (Pro)
    View detailed results in the CompatShield Portal Dashboard.

  • Vulnerability Summary (Pro)
    Get insights into potential plugin vulnerabilities.

  • Email Notifications (Pro)
    Get alerts when risks or issues are detected.

  • “No Data” Plugins Handling
    Identify custom/premium plugins or removed versions not listed on WordPress.org.

🔑 Entry Plan vs Pro Plan

  • PHP Compatibility Check
    $1 Plan: WP Admin results (up to PHP 8.5)
    Pro Plan: Detailed insights in Portal

  • Database Compatibility Check
    $1 Plan: Basic DB version detection in WP Admin
    Pro Plan: Full upgrade readiness + risk analysis + recommendations

  • Plugin Compatibility
    $1 Plan: Basic results
    Pro Plan: Deep analysis + issue breakdown

  • Vulnerability Summary
    $1 Plan: Not available
    Pro Plan: Available

  • Email Notifications
    $1 Plan: Not available
    Pro Plan: Available

  • Portal Dashboard
    $1 Plan: Not available
    Pro Plan: Full access (compatibility + vulnerabilities + reports + history)

  • Custom/Premium Plugin ZIP Scanning
    $1 Plan: Not available
    Pro Plan: Supported

🌐 Subscribe / Upgrade

https://www.compatshield.com/

📸 Screenshots

  1. Main plugin interface with scan results
  2. Plugin compatibility results after scan
  3. Fetching latest results from Portal
  4. Detailed Portal dashboard view

⚙️ Installation

  1. Upload plugin-compatibility-checker to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate via Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Subscribe inside Portal ($1/month)
  4. Enter your license key in plugin settings
  5. Run your first scan

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

What happens if I don’t activate a license?

You must subscribe to the $1/month plan to unlock compatibility results. Without activation, visibility will be limited.

Why is database compatibility important?

Starting with WordPress 7.0, database requirements are stricter (MySQL 8.0+ / MariaDB 10.6+).
Outdated databases may prevent updates and lead to future security risks.

Will my site break if database is outdated?

Not immediately, but your site may stop receiving WordPress updates, making it vulnerable over time.

Why does a plugin show “No Data”?

This means the plugin is custom, premium, or its version is not available on WordPress.org.

Do I need to rescan after installing new plugins?

Yes, click Rescan to include newly added or updated plugins.

🚀 Future Vision

CompatShield is evolving into a complete WordPress Upgrade Intelligence Platform, helping you:

  • Prevent update failures
  • Detect hidden compatibility risks
  • Stay secure and future-ready
